services.title: National Gambling Helpline
services.description: Free, confidential counselling for anyone affected by gambling, including family and friends.

services.title: BetStop
services.description: Exclude yourself from all Australian-licensed online and phone wagering services. Choose a period from 3 months to a lifetime. This does not cover gambling at physical venues.

services.title: National Debt Helpline
services.description: Free, independent financial counselling to help you work through debts, bills and money worries.

services.title: Gamblers Anonymous
services.description: Find Australian in-person and online meetings with people who share their experience of recovering from gambling problems.

services.title: SMART Recovery Australia
services.description: Free group meetings focused on practical skills for changing behaviours, including gambling. Online and in-person options are available.

services.title: Gambling Help Online community
services.description: Read other people's experiences and connect with peers in the gambling support forum.

services.title: Support for family & friends
services.description: Gambling Help Online offers information and counselling for people affected by someone else's gambling. You can get support for yourself too.

services.title: Gam-Anon
services.description: Peer support for family members and friends affected by someone else's gambling. See the Australia and New Zealand meeting information.

services.title: GambleAware NSW
services.description: Find local counselling, financial counselling, self-exclusion support and culturally appropriate services in NSW.

services.title: Gambler's Help
services.description: Explore Victorian gambling support, local counselling and help for family and friends.

services.title: Gambling Help Queensland
services.description: Find regional gambling help services, counselling and support with venue self-exclusion.

services.title: Gambling Help South Australia
services.description: Find local gambling support services and counselling options across South Australia.

services.title: Gambling Help WA
services.description: Explore counselling and support options for Western Australians affected by gambling.

services.title: Gamblers Help Tasmania
services.description: Anglicare Tasmania offers gambling counselling, financial counselling and help with self-exclusion.

services.title: ACT Gambling Support Service
services.description: Free, confidential counselling and outreach for people affected by their own or someone else's gambling.

services.title: Northern Territory gambling support
services.description: Find local counselling, financial support and information about venue self-exclusion in the NT.
